CustomField.formula:
MIN(100, ( (IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Lead", ( IF(ISPICKVAL( Hosted_Before__c , "Yes"), 25,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Hosted_Before__c , "No"), 15,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Hosted_Before__c , "Not Sure"), 13,0) +
IF(ISPICKVAL( Company_Size__c , "Less than 200"), 18,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Company_Size__c , "201 - 500"), 24,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Company_Size__c , "501 - 1000"), 24,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Company_Size__c , "1001 - 1500"), 30,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Company_Size__c , "1501 - more"), 30,0) +
IF(ISPICKVAL( Has_Personal_Story__c , "Yes"), 25,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Has_Personal_Story__c , "No"), 13,0) +
IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"Volunteer Services"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"Blood Donor"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"Humanitarian"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"Financial Donor"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"Service to Armed Forces"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"Disaster Services"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"Health and Safety"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Other_Redcross_Relationships__c,"No Other Relationship"), 10,0) ) , 0) )
+
(IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = "LSL", ( IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = "LSL", 70, 0) +
IF(ISPICKVAL( Age_Group__c , "16 - 18"), 10,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Age_Group__c , "19 - 21"), 10,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Age_Group__c , "21+"), 5,0) +
IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "National Partnership/National Accounts"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Humanitarian Referral"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Prospect List"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Redcross Staff"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Redcross.org"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "redcrossblood.org"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "Inbound Inquiry"), 20,0) + IF(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , "General Referral"), 20,0) ) , 0) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Lead Score
